behavior: AC1 — the classifier decides attested|declined|pending offline from committed JSON fixtures, including one captured verbatim from the real 2026-08-16 CodeRabbit rate-limit comment on #1009. Offline is load-bearing: the notice is only observable while the quota is exhausted, so the fixture is the only reproducible form of the evidence.
verification: bats tests/check-review-attestation.bats -f 'classifies' && test -s tests/fixtures/review-attestation/coderabbit-rate-limited.json && grep -q 'rate limited by coderabbit.ai' tests/fixtures/review-attestation/coderabbit-rate-limited.json

behavior: AC2 — a real review yields attested and exit 0, whether it came from a recognized bot reviewer or from a human. The gate asks whether a review happened, never who performed it.

AC3 — a notice that no review ran yields `declined` and a non-zero exit naming the reviewer and reason; a PR with no reviewer output yields `pending` and a non-zero exit. This is the inversion the whole spec exists for: today both of these render as `CodeRabbit pass`.
verification: ! scripts/check-review-attestation.sh --payload tests/fixtures/review-attestation/coderabbit-rate-limited.json && scripts/check-review-attestation.sh --payload tests/fixtures/review-attestation/coderabbit-rate-limited.json 2>&1 | grep -q 'declined' && ! scripts/check-review-attestation.sh --payload tests/fixtures/review-attestation/no-output.json && scripts/check-review-attestation.sh --payload tests/fixtures/review-attestation/no-output.json 2>&1 | grep -q 'pending'

behavior: AC4 — the declared escape needs BOTH the merged-unreviewed label and a non-empty '## Unreviewed merge rationale' section. All three negative shapes are asserted, not just the positive one: label alone, section alone, and an empty section each still fail. Same shape as spec-gate's skip-sdd escape.

AC5 — reviewers are declared in config, so adding one is an edit to a file rather than to the script. Proven by a fixture whose reviewer is NOT CodeRabbit being classified correctly with no code change, which is what makes PR-Agent (#786) a config entry instead of a rewrite.
verification: grep -qv 'coderabbitai' scripts/check-review-attestation.sh; jq -e '.reviewers | length >= 1' harness/review-attestation.json >/dev/null && bats tests/check-review-attestation.bats -f 'second reviewer'

behavior: AC6 — unreadable input fails closed. No gh, unauthenticated, malformed JSON and an empty response each exit non-zero rather than passing. pattern-verification-fails-toward-unproven: for a gate, refusing to decide must never render as a pass.

AC7 — the gate runs on pull_request AND issue_comment, so a review landing after the checks settled re-runs it with no push. Without issue_comment the gate would only ever answer at the one moment the answer is always 'pending', which is the timing half of the same bug. Paired with an assertion that the step is not continue-on-error, since a gate that decides 'not reviewed' and then reports green would rebuild the defect. The bats case also survives a parser trap worth recording: YAML 1.1 reads the bare key 'on:' as the BOOLEAN true, so a naive d['on'] raises KeyError against every GitHub workflow ever written.
